name: Elderly care homes

problems.words: Families abroad pay late and it's awkward to chase
quick_ideas: Put all fees and dues in one record by account code, so balances are clear
Send every family a bill on the same date, so payment is expected rather than chased.

workzap_build.text: a fee and extras ledger per account code with monthly invoices, local and overseas payments, ageing and polite reminders on schedule.

problems.ask_first: How do overseas families pay now?
problems.free_stops: Reminder tone and timing are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many family payment reminders were sent last week and how many payments arrived after, so awkward chasing is measured.
Give one staff member the weekly dues list in one notebook, so every overdue account gets noticed on the same day.

problems.words: Extras like diapers and special food aren't billed
quick_ideas: Note extras used per account for a week, so you see what is missed
Agree which extras are billable, so staff know.

workzap_build.text: credit_ledger — an extras log where staff record billable items, feeding the monthly invoice automatically.

problems.free_stops: The extras list and billing link are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare a week's extra supplies used with a week's extra charges added, so missed billable items are easier to spot.
Give one person one notebook for all chargeable extras used, so billing picks them up before the week ends.

problems.words: We have empty rooms but enquiries don't convert
quick_ideas: List last month's enquiries with what happened next, so drop-off points are clear
Call back families who visited but didn't decide, with their permission, so they hear from you.

workzap_build.text: an enquiry and admissions pipeline from enquiry to visit, documents, decision and move-in, with follow-up reminders.

problems.ask_first: Where do most enquiries come from?
problems.free_stops: Pipeline stages are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count this week's enquiries, visits and move-ins on one page, so you can see where empty rooms are being lost.
Give one person the visit follow-up list at a fixed afternoon time, so undecided families hear back while interest is fresh.

problems.words: Night staff don't show up and day staff have to stay on
quick_ideas: Keep a standby list for night shifts, so cover is ready
Record no-shows by shift, so patterns show.

workzap_build.text: field_checks — a roster with shift check-in, missed-check-in alerts, sick-call cover and overtime log.

problems.ask_first: Are night staff in-house or agency?
problems.free_stops: Cover and alert rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each late arrival and no-show by shift for one week, so the worst handover times become clear.
Give one supervisor the daily cover list before evening, so replacements are arranged without last-minute confusion.

problems.words: Kitchen supplies run out and someone runs to the market
quick_ideas: Do one count of kitchen staples and set minimum levels, so low stock is visible
Order weekly on a fixed day, so buying is planned.

workzap_build.text: a kitchen and consumables list with par levels, weekly usage and supplier orders sent automatically.

problems.ask_first: Is the kitchen in-house or catered?
problems.free_stops: Par levels are worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note which kitchen items ran short this week and when, so emergency market runs can be tied to specific gaps.
Give one person the weekly kitchen list on one shelf clipboard, so top-up buying happens before staples run out.

problems.words: Diapers, gloves and toiletries disappear faster than they should
quick_ideas: Compare a week of issues with occupancy, so unusual use shows
Keep stock in one locked store with a sign-out sheet, so issues are recorded.

workzap_build.text: dashboards_reports — consumables issued by shift and floor against occupancy, with unusual use flagged.

problems.ask_first: Who has access to the store?
problems.free_stops: The comparison method is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many packs leave the store each day for one week, so unusually fast usage stands out against occupancy.
Give one staff member the store key and one issue notebook, so every pack leaving has a single record.

problems.words: Handover between shifts is verbal and things get missed
quick_ideas: Use one written handover sheet for operational tasks, so nothing relies on memory
Have the next shift lead sign it, so receipt is confirmed.

workzap_build.text: a digital handover note with tasks carried over and acknowledged by the next shift lead, without care-plan content.

problems.ask_first: How many shifts run a day?
problems.free_stops: Handover fields are in the solution document; care content stays with your nursing lead.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many tasks were missed after shift change this week, so the cost of verbal handover is easier to see.
Give each shift lead one handover notebook kept at the desk, so unfinished operational tasks pass forward clearly.

problems.words: Families call all day asking for updates and staff get distracted
quick_ideas: Count family calls for a few days, so the load is known
Set update times for families, so calls are grouped.

workzap_build.text: a family WhatsApp channel for general notices and visiting arrangements, with a request log answered at set times and no resident health details.

problems.free_stops: Channel set-up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note family update calls by hour for a few days, so you can see when staff distraction is heaviest.
Give one person the daily update call window and one list near the desk, so interruptions stop bouncing across staff.

problems.words: Generator, AC and lift breakdowns are fixed only when they fail
quick_ideas: List each item's last service date, so overdue ones are visible
Book the most overdue service now, so one risk is closed.

workzap_build.text: a maintenance schedule for generator, AC, lift and fire equipment with service history and reminders.

problems.free_stops: Service intervals are set with your vendors in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write each breakdown, affected item and lost hours from the past month on one page, so reactive repairs are easier to compare.
Give one person one maintenance notebook for service dates and faults, so overdue checks stop being missed until failure.

problems.words: I can't see occupancy, income and staff cost in one place
quick_ideas: Put this month's occupancy, income, staff cost and utilities on one page, so you have a picture
Add open complaints, so issues sit next to the numbers.

workzap_build.text: a morning read with occupancy, income, receivables, staff cost, utility cost and open complaints.

problems.ask_first: Do you run one home or more?
problems.free_stops: Which numbers appear is set in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write last week's occupied rooms, fee money collected and staff wages paid on one notebook page, so weekly pressure is easier to judge.
Give one person the Friday page update in one notebook kept in the office, so you can check the whole picture quickly.

never_say: Any care, nursing, medication, nutrition, dementia or end-of-life advice.
Any treatment of abuse or neglect as a routine problem; ensure safety, call emergency services and report to the relevant authority.
Interpretations of licensing, staffing ratios or inspection standards.
Help hiding incidents, faking training records or hiring without required checks.
Ideas that record resident names, ages, conditions or room details, or family details.

sample_reply.person: Kai residents ki families bahar mulk mein hain, fees do do mahine late aati hai aur bar bar yaad dilana parta hai. Koi tareeqa batayein.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, is ka tareeqa mojood hai aur shuruat isi hafte ki ja sakti hai. 1) Saari fees aur dues ek hi record mein account code ke saath rakhein, taake har balance saaf ho. 2) Har family ko har mahine ek hi tareekh pe bill bhejein, taake payment yaad dilane ke bajaye mutawaqqa ho. Workzap yeh kaam aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: har mahine invoice, bahar se aane wali payments ka record aur waqt par narm reminders. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
